 Order
Order No. 15.11.2022
02.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application for bail under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with G.R. Case No.85 of 2023 arising out of Kiakata P.S. Case No.10 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M.,
Athamallik for offences punishable under sections 376(2)(n)/417 of the Indian Penal Code.

Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 24.01.2023 and he has been charge sheeted under sections 376(2)(n)/417 of the Indian // 2 // Penal Code and after going through the copy of the charge sheet and statement of the victim, who has stated about her love affairs and physical relationship with the petitioner and on hearing the learned counsel for the State, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper.
